problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 42 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 42 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 40 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 42 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 39 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: size 66 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
